items.name: happy_path
items.requiredTruth: established authentication, observed /cart.html navigation, one directly observed single-cardinality data-test=checkout click, and the /checkout-step-one.html subject-observable oracle reach immutable Product Result through the canonical v3 path

items.name: insufficient_evidence
items.requiredTruth: missing grounding refuses without runnable fiction

items.name: unsupported_action
items.requiredTruth: fill, select, assert_text, drag, and other semantics outside the frozen M1 navigation/click/final-oracle scope refuse closed

items.name: app_area_correctness
items.requiredTruth: persisted PageDefinition.module is carried exactly; mixed and unknown areas refuse

items.name: step_order
items.requiredTruth: reordered, missing, and duplicate steps are detected

items.name: support_provenance
items.requiredTruth: intent, Definition, plan, and UI retain evidence support

items.name: backward_compatibility
items.requiredTruth: v2 remains executable navigation-only; v1 remains readable quarantined and is never upgraded

items.name: execution_failure_truth
items.requiredTruth: final subject-observable oracle failure remains failed despite completed infrastructure

items.name: immutability
items.requiredTruth: Definition, plan, and Result reject in-place mutation

items.name: end_to_end_contract
items.requiredTruth: the exact observed cart-to-checkout fixture can later bind to a Product driver and prove observation through Result
